info.title: Mini Taxi Service
info.description:
Backend MVP of a taxi service in Almaty (KZT).

**Session in Swagger UI** (the browser keeps the HttpOnly cookie itself):

1. `POST /api/v1/auth/register`, then `POST /api/v1/auth/login`.
2. `GET /api/v1/auth/session` and copy `csrf_token`.
3. **Authorize** -> `CsrfToken`: paste the token. It is sent as `X-CSRF-Token`,
   required on every POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE made with the session.
4. `POST /api/v1/auth/logout` ends the session; its CSRF token stops working.

Errors always use the `ErrorResponse` envelope.

AdminUserResponse.title: AdminUserResponse
AdminUserResponse.description: An account in the admin list; ``display_name`` is null without a profile.

ApprovalRequest.title: ApprovalRequest
ApprovalRequest.description: Optional body of an approval; without ``car_class`` the class stays as it is.

google_client_id.title: Google Client Id
google_client_id.description: OAuth client ID for Google Identity Services; null when sign-in with Google is off (hide the button).

anyOf.description: Plain text, 1 to 200 characters after trimming, no control characters.

DriverCard.title: DriverCard
DriverCard.description:
``location`` is the last one sent; a stale one never ends the ride.

After completion both location fields are null (ADR 0007).

anyOf.description: International format; spaces, '-' and brackets are removed: '+7 701 123-45-67' is stored as '+77011234567'.
Driving licence number; stored upper case without spaces or '-'.

DriverProfileUpdate.title: DriverProfileUpdate
DriverProfileUpdate.description: Changing the name, licence or vehicle of an approved driver returns them to pending.

location_updated_at.title: Location Updated At
location_updated_at.description: Server time of the last location.

missing_fields.title: Missing Fields
missing_fields.description: Fields still needed before approval; empty when complete.

rating.description: Stars the driver received from passengers.

DriverResponse.title: DriverResponse
DriverResponse.description: A driver's profile, vehicle, approval, availability and current location.

credential.title: Credential
credential.description: Google ID token (JWT) from Google Identity Services: the `credential` of the sign-in callback.

LocationUpdate.title: LocationUpdate
LocationUpdate.description: Current position; the time of the update is the server's, not the client's.

rating.description: Stars received from the other side of rides (count 0 for an admin).

login_method.description: google for an account made by Google sign-in.

email.title: Email
email.description: The Google account's email; null for a password login.

MyProfileResponse.title: MyProfileResponse
MyProfileResponse.description: The caller's account and contact details; empty until set by PATCH.

anyOf.description: Name shown to other participants of a ride.
International format; spaces, '-' and brackets are removed: '+7 701 123-45-67' is stored as '+77011234567'.

MyProfileUpdate.title: MyProfileUpdate
MyProfileUpdate.description: Only these fields are writable; role, username and approval are not.

payment_method.description: How the passenger pays for the ride.

PaymentResponse.title: PaymentResponse
PaymentResponse.description:
``payment_url`` is the configured Kaspi link for ``kaspi_link``, otherwise null.

``paid`` never proves that money arrived: Kaspi is a simulated charge (ADR 0010).

options.title: Options
options.description: Every tariff, cheapest first: economy, comfort, comfort_plus, business.

kaspi_payment_url.title: Kaspi Payment Url
kaspi_payment_url.description: The configured Kaspi link (pay.kaspi.kz) or null when Kaspi is off. Opening it charges nothing: a Kaspi ride counts as paid once a driver accepts it.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: The passenger about the driver: polite, clean_car, smooth_driving, knows_route; the driver about the passenger: on_time, polite, clean. Repeats are dropped.

comment.title: Comment
comment.description: Up to 500 characters after trimming; blank is null.

RatingSummaryResponse.title: RatingSummaryResponse
RatingSummaryResponse.description: Average stars received (two decimals), null without ratings.

username.title: Username
username.description: 3-32 ASCII letters, digits or '_'; unique regardless of case.

password.title: Password
password.description: 10-128 characters; stored only as an Argon2id hash.

role.title: Role
role.description: Public registration creates passengers or drivers only; role 'admin' is rejected with 422 (admins are created by scripts/create_admin.py).

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Plain text, 1 to 200 characters after trimming, no control characters.

payment_method.description: Chosen with the order. kaspi_link needs KASPI_PAYMENT_URL and counts as paid when a driver accepts the ride (a simulated charge, no money is checked); its link is kaspi_payment_url of the quote and payment_url of GET /rides/{ride_id}/payment.

tariff.description: The ride costs this tariff's amount from the quote; only cars of this class or higher are offered the ride.

driver.description: Only for the passenger and the driver while the ride is assigned, arrived, in_progress or completed (then without location); otherwise null.

my_rating.description: The rating the caller gave this ride; null until they rate it (always null for an admin).

RideSummary.title: RideSummary
RideSummary.description: A list item without the route geometry; payment fields are null only without a payment.

RouteGeometry.title: RouteGeometry
RouteGeometry.description: GeoJSON LineString; every position is ``[longitude, latitude]``.

RouteRequest.title: RouteRequest
RouteRequest.description: Two points of a road route, in driving order.

RouteResult.title: RouteResult
RouteResult.description: Road route normalized from an external provider.

csrf_token.title: Csrf Token
csrf_token.description: Send it as the X-CSRF-Token header with every POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE made with this session. Valid until logout or expiry.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: Server time (UTC) when the session ends.

plate_number.title: Plate Number
plate_number.description: Unique across drivers; '123 abc-02' is stored as '123ABC02'.

year.title: Year
year.description: Model year from 1980 to next year.

VehicleInput.title: VehicleInput
VehicleInput.description: The driver's one car; sending it replaces all of its fields.

car_class.description: Set by an admin; serves its tariff and lower ones.

SessionCookie.description: HttpOnly session cookie set by POST /api/v1/auth/login.
SessionCookie.name: taxi_session

CsrfToken.description: csrf_token from GET /api/v1/auth/session; required on unsafe methods.
CsrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
